description.value: Canuck Empire Brewing is a microbrewery and taproom in Abbotsford billing itself as making 'Distinctive Beer for Off Beat Canadians.' The taproom offers a rotating slate of house-brewed beers alongside a small snack menu including pretzels and grilled cheese. A weekly specials program and regular events make it a lively stop for visitors passing through the Fraser Valley.
